response.sql: WITH station_usage AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS station_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS station_fraction FROM station_usage GROUP BY lunarstage;
